instruction: Search for Dota 2 in the Steam store and add the International Battle Pass to your cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Dota 2 in Steam store and adding Battle Pass DLC to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Similar complexity to original Dota 2 task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator uses get_page_info getter to fetch Steam cart page content
Metric is_added_to_steam_cart checks if expected item 'Dota 2 - The International 2023 Battle Pass' is in page content
This correctly verifies the instruction requirement to add the International Battle Pass to cart
The getter can access the cart URL (https://store.steampowered.com/cart/) to extract page content
The metric performs string matching to verify cart contents, which is appropriate for this verification
Evaluator logic flow: fetch cart page -> extract HTML content -> search for item name in content -> return 1 if found, 0 if not
No postconfig needed as cart state persists after task completion
